text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] runtime-pool-3 queue depth spike detected — p95 token latency 3.2s, inflight 124, error rate +4% over 5m. Pager: @mike_oncall. Link: https://observability/redwood/inc/4350009876
mike_oncall: acked, joining channel. grabbing logs + traces.
mike_oncall: looks like embedding requests causing long KV refill ops, lots of streaming sessions. inflight cap is 256.
raj_runtime: seeing headroom exhausted on G4s, GC pauses around 200 reqs. Suggest lowering max_inflight to 64 and enable soft-shedding for low-priority.
sasha_prod: +1 to lowering max_inflight. Also can flip feature flag streaming_v2 -> off for a subset of customers to reduce long tails.
leah_support: which customers impacted? any enterprise traffic we need to protect?
mike_oncall: list from live query: prod-analytics, partner-xyz, free-tier bots mainly. enterprise customers at 99th still ok. I'll avoid global quota drops.
raj_runtime: prepared quick command to set new inflight and enable shedding:
```bash
redwoodctl runtime update --pool runtime-pool-3 --max-inflight=64 --enable-soft-shed=true
```
raj_runtime: will apply now, will monitor for 30s.
sre-bot: job started: runtime-update-4350009876 (initiated by raj_runtime)
incident-bot: mitigation started by raj_runtime — reducing max_inflight to 64. Expected immediate drop in queueing. Continue monitoring.
mike_oncall: applied. seeing inflight drop to ~70, p95 down to 1.1s. errors stable.
sasha_prod: flipping FF streaming_v2 off for non-enterprise: `ffctl set streaming_v2=false --scope non-enterprise`
leah_support: notifying partner-xyz via support channel, telling them we're doing mitigations, low risk to enterprise.
mike_oncall: temporary quota bump for partner-xyz revoked; we re-applied normal limits to avoid burst. partner confirms slight degraded but acceptable.
raj_runtime: timeout tuning applied for embedding path: reduce request timeout from 60s -> 20s for non-critical queue. Command:
```bash
redwoodctl runtime config set --pool runtime-pool-3 --path /embed --timeout 20s
```
mike_oncall: tailing logs, no new errors, latency steady. handing off to sasha_prod for next 4h oncall.
sasha_prod: taking over. will keep watch and if anything regresses I'll escalate to infra oncall. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: incident note: mitigations applied: max_inflight=64, soft_shedding=on, streaming_v2=off(non-enterprise), embed-timeout=20s. Closing pager for now. Link: https://observability/redwood/inc/4350009876/notes
